attributes.name: Tome Eater
attributes.powers:
When you encounter a boon that has the Book trait or a spell, discard this card to automatically acquire it, then you may banish the boon to shuffle 1d4+1 random cards from your discard pile into your deck. 

Discard this card to explore your location.
